Title: Account Balance Synchronization System
Description: Implement a robust real-time balance synchronization system that ensures account balances are immediately updated across all user interfaces when credits or debits are applied. As a bank customer, I want my account balance to reflect all transactions immediately so that I can make informed financial decisions and trust the accuracy of my account information.
Priority: Must Have - Critical system integrity issue affecting customer trust and regulatory compliance
Acceptance Criteria: Account balances update immediately when receiving credit transactions | Balance changes are reflected across all UI components (dashboard, account cards, transaction history) | System maintains data consistency between transaction records and displayed balances | Real-time event system notifies UI components of balance changes | Balance reconciliation checks prevent discrepancies between backend and frontend
Technical Notes: Requires implementation of event-driven architecture for real-time updates. Must handle concurrent transactions safely with proper locking mechanisms.

Title: Transaction History with Advanced Filtering
Description: Create a comprehensive transaction history view with advanced filtering and search capabilities. As a bank customer, I want to easily find and review my past transactions with flexible filtering options so that I can track my spending patterns and locate specific transactions quickly.
Priority: Must Have - Essential for customer account management and regulatory requirements
Acceptance Criteria: Display transactions in reverse chronological order (newest first) | Filter by date range, transaction type, amount range, and account | Search functionality for transaction descriptions and account numbers | Pagination for performance with large transaction volumes | Export functionality for customer records (CSV/PDF)
Technical Notes: Implement efficient database indexing for transaction queries. Consider caching strategies for frequently accessed data.

Title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
Description: Implement multi-factor authentication to enhance account security beyond username/password. As a bank customer, I want additional security layers protecting my account so that my financial information remains secure even if my password is compromised.
Priority: Must Have - Critical security requirement for financial applications
Acceptance Criteria: Support SMS, email, and authenticator app-based MFA | Require MFA for high-value transactions (configurable threshold) | Remember trusted devices for specified periods | Backup recovery codes for account access | Admin panel for MFA management and user support
Technical Notes: Integrate with third-party MFA providers (Twilio, Auth0). Ensure GDPR compliance for storing phone numbers and backup codes.

Title: Automated Transaction Categorization
Description: Implement intelligent transaction categorization that automatically assigns categories to transactions based on merchant names, amounts, and patterns. As a bank customer, I want my transactions automatically categorized so that I can easily track my spending across different categories without manual effort.
Priority: Should Have - Valuable feature for customer financial management
Acceptance Criteria: Auto-categorize transactions using merchant data and ML algorithms | Allow customers to manually override and customize categories | Provide spending insights and reports by category | Support custom category creation and management | Learn from user corrections to improve accuracy
Technical Notes: Requires machine learning model training and merchant database integration. Consider using third-party categorization services initially.

Title: Scheduled and Recurring Transfers
Description: Enable customers to set up scheduled one-time transfers and recurring transfer patterns. As a bank customer, I want to schedule automatic transfers for bills and savings so that I can automate my financial management and never miss important payments.
Priority: Should Have - Important convenience feature for customer retention
Acceptance Criteria: Schedule one-time future transfers with specific dates | Set up recurring transfers (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) | Modify or cancel scheduled transfers before execution | Email notifications before scheduled transfer execution | Handle insufficient funds scenarios gracefully
Technical Notes: Implement background job processing system. Ensure proper error handling and retry mechanisms for failed scheduled transfers.

Title: Account Alerts and Notifications
Description: Provide customizable account alerts for various account activities and thresholds. As a bank customer, I want to receive notifications about important account activities so that I can stay informed about my finances and detect unauthorized transactions quickly.
Priority: Should Have - Important for security and customer engagement
Acceptance Criteria: Configurable alerts for low balance, large transactions, login attempts | Multiple notification channels (email, SMS, push notifications) | Real-time alerts for suspicious activity detection | Customer preference management for alert types and thresholds | Alert history and management dashboard
Dependencies: Multi-Factor Authentication, Account Balance Synchronization System
Technical Notes: Integrate with notification services (SendGrid, Twilio). Implement rate limiting to prevent notification spam.

Title: Mobile-Responsive Design Optimization
Description: Optimize the entire application for mobile devices with responsive design and touch-friendly interfaces. As a mobile bank customer, I want a seamless banking experience on my smartphone so that I can manage my finances conveniently from anywhere.
Priority: Should Have - Critical for customer accessibility and modern banking expectations
Acceptance Criteria: Fully responsive design across all screen sizes (320px to 1920px+) | Touch-optimized interface elements and gestures | Fast loading times on mobile networks | Offline capability for viewing account information | Progressive Web App (PWA) features for app-like experience
Dependencies: All existing UI components need mobile optimization
Technical Notes: Implement CSS Grid/Flexbox for responsive layouts. Consider service workers for offline functionality. Test across multiple devices and browsers.

Title: Account Statement Generation
Description: Generate downloadable account statements for specified date ranges in multiple formats. As a bank customer, I want to download official account statements so that I can maintain records for tax purposes, loan applications, and personal financial tracking.
Priority: Could Have - Valuable for customer record-keeping but not critical for core functionality
Acceptance Criteria: Generate statements for custom date ranges | Support multiple formats (PDF, CSV, Excel) | Include account summary, transaction details, and bank branding | Digital signatures or watermarks for authenticity | Email delivery option for generated statements
Technical Notes: Use PDF generation libraries (jsPDF, Puppeteer). Ensure proper formatting and bank compliance standards for official statements.

Title: Spending Analytics Dashboard
Description: Provide visual analytics and insights about customer spending patterns, trends, and financial health. As a bank customer, I want to see visual representations of my spending habits so that I can make better financial decisions and understand my money flow.
Priority: Could Have - Nice-to-have feature that enhances customer value but not essential
Acceptance Criteria: Interactive charts showing spending by category, time period, and trends | Monthly/yearly spending comparisons and insights | Budget tracking and goal-setting capabilities | Predictive insights for future spending patterns | Exportable reports and visualizations
Dependencies: Automated Transaction Categorization, Transaction History with Advanced Filtering
Technical Notes: Implement charting libraries (Chart.js, D3.js). Consider data aggregation strategies for performance. May require data warehouse for complex analytics.

Title: Customer Support Chat Integration
Description: Integrate a customer support chat system with account context for immediate assistance. As a bank customer, I want to quickly get help with my account issues through live chat so that I can resolve problems without calling customer service.
Priority: Could Have - Enhances customer service but not core banking functionality
Acceptance Criteria: Live chat widget accessible from all application pages | Customer service representatives can view account context (with permission) | Chat history preservation and searchability | Automated responses for common questions | Escalation to phone support when needed
Technical Notes: Integrate with customer service platforms (Zendesk, Intercom). Ensure proper security and privacy controls for account information sharing.
